steps.text: Steam whole head of cauliflower for 30 minutes. Drain and place on a pie plate.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
In a mixing bowl, combine mayonnaise and mustard; spread the mixture over cauliflower and dot with pats of butter. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven uncovered, for about 30 minutes, or until cheese is brown.

raw_recipe.headline: Cheesy Baked Cauliflower
raw_recipe.description: A delicious cauliflower dish, baked whole with cheese for an impressive presentation and melt-in-your-mouth taste. Great as a side or vegetarian entree.
raw_recipe.name: Cheesy Baked Cauliflower

review.reviewBody: I've been making this recipe for years and my tip for this recipe is to add the parmesan to the mustard/mayo mixture before you spread it on the cauliflower. Less waste!

I'll start by saying that I used broccoli instead of cauliflower and that my kids and I never liked either vegis before. This is how I steamed my broccoli: I placed about 1 lb of flowerets in a gallon-sized freezer ziploc with 3 Tbsp chicken broth and sealed all except an inch and set it in my microwave for 3 minutes. When it was ready, I spooned the sauce over the broccoli and placed it back in the microwave for about 20 seconds. Took it out and stirred. It was marvelous! Oh... and I also used I can't believe it's not butter! light, and best foods reduced fat mayo as substitute

Another great addition to the not-so-usual dinner portfolio. This is an excellent side dish and easy to make.

I did however tweak things a wee bit... but only in the presentation. I trimmed up a head of cauliflower, "steamed" it in the microwave wieht about a half cup of water, leaving the entire head intact to cook until it was just about "al dente". 

Then I continued with the above recipe but increased the amount of mayonnaise to 3 tablespoons and the prepared mustard to 2 teaspoons. Then folded in grated Parmesan (half cup). This mixture I spread over the par-cooked head of cauliflower then proceeded to bake as directed.

The result was a nice golden brown presentation of cauliflower that we simply sliced to serve. Not the usual veggie side dish!

This is my new favorite way to cook cauliflower! I just knew the small amount of mayonnaise and mustard couldn't possibly cover all that cauliflower, but it did. I spread it on with a pastry brush. I cut the butter down to 2 T. and added salt, and it was perfect. I do think, though, that the steam time could be about 10-15 minutes.

This was a better alternative than just boiling cauliflower. Steamed in the microwave for 5 minutes, as others suggested, and I upped the mayo & mustard to 1 Tbspn each. I sprinkled some shredded cheddar on top before serving and skipped the butter. 2nd Note: put non-stick spray on the baking dish.

very good , I did only steam cauliflower for 10 min. and added a bit more mayo and some extra cheese I had on hand some colby jack I put half steamed cauliflower in cassarole dish put two slices of american cheese then added rest of cauilflower . I did mix rest of all the ingredients together before putting on cauiflower. Company Good!!! oh one more thing, I sprinkle just a few crushed corn flakes on top and some green onions just to look nice.

The whole family really enjoyed this dish! Cut into smaller pieces and steamed for 15 minutes. Upped the mayo and mustard to a Tbsp, added about a tsp of garlic powder and 1/4 C shredded cheddar. Combined the mayo, mustard, butter, cheeses, and garlic powder and tossed with pieces of steamed cauliflower prior to baking.

I thought it was great! I took others' advice about a short steam for cauliflower, but also added brocolli florets. Then I increased the mayonaise (2 tbs) and mustard (1 tbs), added minced garlic and pepper, and mixed all that together with half of the shredded cheddar. The rest of the cheese I sprinkled over the top. The one thing I wish I hadn't done differently was using dijon mustard, it was a bit overpowering.

Steamed cauliflower in microwave for only 5 minutes - that was sufficient.
added 1 heaping tablespoon mayo, 1T mustard, sprinkle of cayenne, 1 clove garlic crushed. yummy!
Will add a little more cayenne or spicy paprika and a little salt to taste - maybe 1/2 teaspoon - next time.

YUMMY!!! only changes were out of necessity... I didn't have any mayo on hand so I substituted with miracle whip and used spicy brown mustard. Also used a generous tablespoon of each instead of tsp. Hubby and I at the entire head without blinking. Also, I microwave steamed the cauliflower for about 7 minutes on the raw vegetable setting. New favorite way to eat cauliflower.

very yummy! like everyone else said, I steamed it for 15 minutes, 30 minutes would be way too long. i used a tablespoon of mayo and a tablespoon of mustard, and instead of dotting the butter on top, I melted it and sautéed some onions and garlic in the butter, then poured it over the top, then topped with cheese. I think next time I would use less butter, because between the butter and mayo it was pretty slippery...but delicious!!!
I think the mayo/Mustard ratio is way off. It should be maybe a tsp of Mustard to 1/2 cup or more mayo

I’ve been baking this for years. Use Dijon mustard ( at least a tbsp), no butter but a mixture of grated cheddar cheese and Parmesan mixed together with the wet ingredients to make a paste. Pack onto the steamed cauliflower and bake. It’s always been a hit. A bit more flavourful with these few tweaks.
Forgot the butter. Still came out great. Served with two and a half inch steaks and my friend raved most about the cauliflower!

I make a very similar recipe. Instead of Parmesan, I use a mixture of sharp cheddar and jack cheese. This one is a bit too greasy and I used half the butter called for. I also seasoned the cauliflower with salt and pepper. Otherwise it would have been on the bland side.
Husband went nuts over this. I thought it was pretty good also. Right up our alley for Low Carb.
Such a simple recipe, but really good! Will make this often! Thank you!

I steamed it for 10 first I made the sauce with like 3/4 cup mayo fair amount of honey mustard(sweet baby rays ) and 1 1/4 ish cup of parm .. tastes great I love it next time tho I’ll put some olive oil over it first for the roasting process

Instead of a head of cauliflower, I use frozen bagged florets. I microwave them first, then put in bowl. Mix the butter, mayo and mustard, then mix with the cauliflower. I usually make double the mixture for a family size bag of cauliflower. Put in baking dish and sprinkle the Parmesan over the top. I have also added a little pepper and cubed grilled chicken.
